# Legacy Export Notes

Frozen notes from the older export. Kept for reference only.

## What is here

- Flat tags that no longer match the current vocabulary
- Notes whose attachments were never migrated
- Links that resolve only after the Atlas cutover

## Do not edit

This folder is archived. New work belongs in [[_Workspace/40-Projects/atlas-migration/README]].

> [!warning] Archive is read-only by policy
